summary: Validation failed with 3 major violations (loading state, hardcoded colors) and 1 minor chain violation.

violations.detail: isOtpLoading and isAuthLoading only check for 'loading' status, skipping 'idle' check required to prevent flashes.
Hardcoded hex color #DCE8F7 used directly in component props.
Stylesheet uses multiple hardcoded hex values (e.g., #1A73E8, #BDBDBD) instead of design tokens.
Service layer returns mock data instead of using ApiService, breaking the mandatory Screen -> hook -> saga -> service -> ApiService chain.
